subject.title: Wear: animate Talk avatar from playback audio

question: Should Wear Talk replace its existing orb-and-waveform presentation with the animated OpenClaw avatar as the default user-facing interaction state?
rationale: The patch is a deliberate product and visual-language change, not a correction to an established behavior contract; source review cannot determine the intended default experience.

options.title: Adopt the avatar default
options.body: Accept the animated avatar as the Wear Talk default and continue normal Android/Wear review of the current implementation.

options.title: Keep the existing visual
options.body: Retain the orb and waveform, closing or narrowing this feature proposal because the current visual remains the desired product direction.

options.title: Request a narrower visual experiment
options.body: Ask for a scoped prototype or design decision before replacing the existing production Talk presentation.

recommendation.title: Adopt the avatar default
recommendation.body: Accept the animated avatar as the Wear Talk default and continue normal Android/Wear review of the current implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product-direction decision about a default OpenClaw identity surface, not a narrowly owned implementation defect.
